items.title: Indian Navy Removes Unexploded Missile Warhead from Kochi-Bound Oil Tanker
items.whyInNews: The Indian Navy successfully removed an unexploded missile warhead from a Kochi-bound oil tanker, ensuring the safety of the crew and the vessel.
items.summary: The Indian Navy received a distress call from the oil tanker, which was carrying a cargo of crude oil from the Middle East to Kochi. The successful removal of the warhead ensured the safety of the crew and the vessel, and it highlights the Indian Navy's capabilities in handling such situations.
